claims: The 2026 Men's Final Four games are UConn vs. Illinois and Michigan vs. Arizona.
The 2026 Men's Final Four games are on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
TBS, TNT, and truTV are the primary broadcasters for the Final Four.
Game 1 of the Final Four on April 4, 2026 is UConn vs. Illinois at 6:09 p.m. ET on TBS/TNT/truTV.
Game 2 of the Final Four on April 4, 2026 is Michigan vs. Arizona and follows the first game on TBS/TNT/truTV.
Max (formerly HBO Max) streams all games broadcasting on TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Sling TV offers a "Day Pass" for roughly $4.99.
Hulu + Live TV carries Turner networks (TBS/TNT).
The March Madness Live app is free to download.
The March Madness Live app requires a TV provider login to watch the games.
Games for the women's tournament are accessible via ESPN.
